sources.description:
Hou Xiangting’s Journey of Love

Hou Xiangting appears in a close-up portrait, glancing over her shoulder with a warm smile. The softly blurred street scene behind her sets a casual, urban tone. Bold pink and yellow text reads “angel 爱之旅 journey of love,” framing the album’s theme of romance and optimism.

Released in 2001, Journey of Love features 17 tracks spanning 50 minutes. This Apple Music release showcases Hou Xiangting’s gentle vocal style and approachable image, inviting listeners into a heartfelt musical journey.

sources.title: 秋天別來 - Angel Hou: Song Lyrics, Music Videos & Concerts
sources.description:
Angel Hou Self-Titled Debut Album Cover

Angel Hou’s 1999 debut album presents a soft-focus close-up of the singer’s face, emphasizing her clear skin, gentle expression, and subtle makeup. The green vertical text on the left reads “不一樣的侯湘婷，多面向的唱歌實力 一次給你,” while her name “侯湘婷” and “同名專輯” appear on the right.

Released by Gold Typhoon Taiwan on January 1, 1999, the album features the Mandopop single “秋天別來,” which carries a BPM of 135 and balances melodicness, acousticness, valence, danceability, and energy. Angel Hou performs the tracks, with Chien Yao and Sky Wu credited for composition and lyrics, showcasing her versatile vocal abilities.

sources.title: 侯湘婷 | Spotify
sources.description:
侯湘婷 Album Cover

A serene album cover features Taiwanese singer 侯湘婷 in a close-up portrait set against rolling green hills. Her brown hair gently frames her face as she looks directly at the viewer with a calm expression. Overlaid white text reads “侯(湘婷) 你爱我吗? Do You Love Me?”, combining Chinese characters with an English subtitle.

This artwork serves as the cover image for 侯湘婷’s Spotify artist page, where she garners 45.1K monthly listeners. The natural outdoor setting and soft lighting create a peaceful, pastoral atmosphere that complements the album’s introspective title.

Hou Xiangting’s Fitness Comeback

Former Mandopop star Hou Xiangting returned to the spotlight on May 30, 2015, attending a promotional event for SpaceCycle, an indoor cycling brand co-founded by her mentor Yao Qian and talent scout Matthew.
